name: find_similar_issues
description: Finds issues whose titles look similar to a given issue, to spot duplicates or related reports.

arguments.name: issue_number
arguments.description: Number of the issue to compare against.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: Maximum number of similar issues to return (default 5).

returns.name: similar_issues
returns.description: Numbers of similar issues, most similar first.

examples: Has this bug been reported before?
